note: Plain-English description of each occupation filter, plus the government-vs-private sub-occupation mix for Legal and Protective service (ACS PUMS, employed 25-64).

software_it.includes: Software developers, IT and systems administration, data, cybersecurity, and other computer occupations (SOC 15-1).

legal.includes: Lawyers, judges, paralegals, and legal support workers (SOC 23).

finance.includes: Accountants, auditors, financial analysts, and examiners (SOC 13-2).

engineering.includes: Civil, mechanical, electrical, and other professional engineers (SOC 17-2).

management.includes: Managers, directors, and executives across all functions (SOC 11).

healthcare.includes: Physicians, nurses, pharmacists, therapists, and other clinicians (SOC 29).

protective_service.includes: Police, firefighters, corrections officers, detectives, and security guards (SOC 33).

skilled_trades.includes: Electricians, plumbers, mechanics, and other building and repair trades (SOC 47 and 49).

admin_clerical.includes: Clerks, secretaries, administrative specialists, and postal workers (SOC 43).
